claims.text: The initial NbMoTaW alloy is equiatomic.
The initial NbMoTaW alloy is single-phase BCC.
NbMoTaW has excellent high-temperature strength, including at approximately 1600 °C.
NbMoTaW has poor room-temperature ductility.
Experimental irradiation resistance has not been confirmed for the initial NbMoTaW alloy.
Approximately 10 at.% V should be introduced by substitutional alloying of NbMoTaW.
NbMoTaW0.9V0.1 is an example of a NbMoTaW alloy containing approximately 10 at.% V.
The V-modified alloy will retain a BCC structure.
V addition will induce a fine-scale, possibly dual-phase microstructure containing coherent V-rich regions or precipitates in a BCC matrix.
The V-rich regions or precipitates will improve low-temperature dislocation mobility.
The V-rich regions or precipitates will act as irradiation-defect sinks.
Vanadium is more ductile than tungsten in the context relevant to this substitution.
Replacing part of the W with V will decrease room-temperature solid-solution strength.
The decrease in solid-solution strength will increase dislocation mobility and room-temperature ductility.
V-rich nanostructural features will promote irradiation-defect annihilation or recombination.
Defect annihilation or recombination will reduce helium bubbles, blistering, amorphization, and other irradiation-induced defect accumulation.
The V-modified alloy will have significantly greater room-temperature ductility than untreated NbMoTaW.
The V-modified alloy will have a lower density of irradiation-induced defects, with reduced blistering and irradiation-enhanced precipitation, than untreated NbMoTaW.
The V-modified alloy will retain high-temperature yield strength similar to untreated NbMoTaW at 1600 °C.
The proposed benefits will apply from room temperature through 1600 °C and under helium implantation or reactor-relevant irradiation.

contradictions.description: The stated formula NbMoTaW0.9V0.1 normalizes to Nb25Mo25Ta25W22.5V2.5 at.%, not approximately 10 at.% V. If V substitutes only for W while Nb, Mo, and Ta remain at 25 at.% each, a 10 at.% V composition would instead be Nb25Mo25Ta25W15V10, corresponding proportionally to NbMoTaW0.6V0.4.
